title: Asset Production Governance, Locking, Dependency & Review Layer
objective: Build an ARI-aware production overlay over existing VCS/storage: source-vs-generated distinction, large/binary asset status, advisory/exclusive locks where backend supports them, derivative/dependency impact, stale-build detection, review/approval state, task/owner linkage, batch provenance and cache/build visibility.

scope.purpose: Provide ARI-aware asset-production governance over existing VCS/storage without replacing the underlying version-control or storage authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative production assets can expose inspectable governance, lock/dependency/review/provenance and stale-build evidence over existing VCS/storage while ARI identity/provenance rules remain authoritative and no replacement VCS is created.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-14 exact-tree publication. PCA-15's PCA-01 gate is satisfied, so PCA-15 is the lawful active item.
MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked until PCA-15 is completed and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER is satisfied; this tranche does not start any studio family.
PCA-15 is an ARI-aware overlay over existing VCS/storage and does not implement a replacement VCS or storage authority.

Locking semantics apply only where the underlying backend supports them; unsupported exclusive-lock behavior must fail closed or degrade explicitly to advisory status rather than pretending exclusivity.

ARI identity/provenance remains authoritative; PCA-15 may project source/generated, derivative/dependency, review/task/provenance and cache/build visibility without minting a second canonical asset ledger.
PCA-16, MCS, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this tranche.
next_action: Establish the smallest causal RED for PCA-15 through the public asset-production-governance seam before writing production implementation.
